entities.summary: Javier Justiz Ferrer is a Cuban professional basketball player for Libertadores de Querétaro of the Liga Nacional de Baloncesto Profesional (LNBP). He has earlier spent three seasons with Basket Zaragoza of the Liga ACB in Spain.
